items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern redraw of a historical script form
items.tradition: Chinese seal script; Commons attributes the model to Hanziyuan image S01572
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 路 in Shuowen seal-script style, a received form associated with the analysis of 足 and 各.
items.alt: Commons identifies the graphic as a seal-script-style form of 路; the image pixels were not inspected in this research run.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies the character and script style, provides its original image link, and states public-domain terms. It offers a script-form example, though it cannot document earlier graphic development.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons file description; attribution is appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw rather than an ancient artifact photograph. The direct SVG request failed, so its pixels were not inspected in this run.
